label: agent
scenario: Upbeat moving-company voicebot gets barged in on mid-sentence and recovers; claims 'you're all booked' but gives no confirmation number and sends nothing.
task: Book a local one-bedroom move for Saturday, October 3rd.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks for calling Two Rivers Moving! I'm Max, the booking assistant. Are you looking to schedule a move or get a quote?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hi Max, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of my customer, Oliver Brandt. He'd like to book a local move for Saturday, October 3rd, from a one-bedroom apartment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great, a one-bedroom local move. Let me grab a few details. What's the pickup address and the drop-off address?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Pickup is 55 Harlow Street, apartment 2A, and drop-off is 1208 Wren Court. Both are in Millbrook.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Perfect. For a one-bedroom, we'd send two movers and a sixteen-foot truck at a rate of one hundred twenty-nine dollars an hour, with a three-hour minimum. I have availability on Saturday, October 10th, starting at eight AM, or—

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Sorry to interrupt, the date is Saturday, October 3rd, not the 10th.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No problem. For Saturday, October 3rd, I have an eight AM or a one PM arrival window.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Awesome, you're all booked for Saturday, October 3rd at eight AM with two movers!

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Great. Can I get a booking confirmation number, or will you send a confirmation by email or text?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The booking is saved under Oliver's name, so he doesn't need a number. Our team usually reaches out a few days before the move.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Is a deposit required to hold the date?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great question! Deposit details are handled by our moving coordinators. Is there anything else I can help with today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks for choosing Two Rivers Moving!
